name: @tejoma/role-intelligence-service
description: Tejoma Role Intelligence Service - Tier 0 (Batch 29, fifth slice of the Matching domain). Owns a dual-written mirror of role_profiles and the read-only role-resolution logic (matchRoleByTitle) - resolving an arbitrary JD title to the closest known role profile by embedding similarity. The monolith remains the sole writer (its own admin seed script, scripts/seed-intelligence-layer.ts, unchanged) - several background modules (dynamicWeighting.ts, careerWeighting.ts, proficiencyWeighting.ts, recencyWeighting.ts, futureRolePrediction.ts) still read role_profiles directly from the monolith's own database and are not affected by this extraction.
